description: Fetches a Reddit user's public profile by username. Returns account info: username, id, karma (post + comment), account age, verified/employee flags, and avatar. Example: name='spez'.

name.description: Reddit username WITHOUT the u/ prefix (e.g. 'spez'). Required (path parameter). Required: send `name` or its alias `username`.

username.description: Alias of `name`; send one of them. `name` is the canonical name.

name: reddit_user_profile
title: Get User Profile
